entries.summary: Manage the chat you are reading from its title menu, or from More in the Duo's vertical bar, with the same actions as the sidebar row: pin, duplicate, rename, move, export, archive and delete. Archive and delete apply at once and roll back if the server refuses.

Chat actions follow display and accessibility changes, and archiving a parent chat keeps its open fork intact. If deleting an archived chat loses its connection, the chat returns when the server still has it.
